                    current.append('"')
                    i += 2
                    continue

                i += 1
                continue
            current.append(ch)
            i += 1
        else:
            if ch == '"':
                in_quotes = True
                i += 1
            elif ch == ',':
                fields.append(''.join(current))
                current = []
                i += 1
            else:
                current.append(ch)
                i += 1
    fields.append(''.join(current))
    return fields
